name: What is the process a professional contractor follows for caulking repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the process a professional contractor follows for caulking repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional caulking repair process typically begins with a thorough inspection to assess the existing caulk and identify problem areas. Next, the old caulk is carefully removed using specialized tools, followed by cleaning and preparing the surface to ensure proper adhesion of the new caulk. Any loose debris, dirt, or mildew is removed. The new, appropriate type of caulk is then applied smoothly and evenly into the joints. Finally, the caulk is tooled for a clean finish and allowed to cure according to manufacturer specifications, ensuring a durable, watertight seal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals inspect, remove old caulk, clean surfaces, apply new caulk smoothly, tool for finish, and allow it to cure for a durable, watertight seal.
